procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session, without spawn, fork, resume, peer records or producer explanations. Read the pinned case, complete packet, rules, rubric, recording instructions and adapter; verified the declared input bytes and PNG headers. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before the image opens, without following their unlisted source/input/final paths. The packet declares zero source assets and zero protected-layout manifests, so there were no source opens or protected-geometry reads to perform. Actually opened and visually inspected M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; then M2 in those three views; then M3; then M4; then M5, using tools.view_image with detail original and functions image output, one exact pinned file per open. All fifteen displayed poster views were complete before beginning deliberate copy transcription, any image judgment or any score. Transcribed the first raw readings from the already displayed native pixels, retaining the two visible title line breaks, and assessed usage720 readability and thumbnail hierarchy from their displayed views. No ambiguity revisit was needed or performed. Receipts attest to these actual opens, not to a helper result or a filename. No runtime session ID or serialized opening event is claimed.

image_material.observation: The block face shows a connected looping relief with enclosed dark channels, while the paper shows three detached swept strokes. image_material.location: lower edge of raised block against the yellow paper
image_material.observation: The block presents its whole carved face toward the viewer, with only a narrow lower corner approaching the sheet. The reveal/stamping gesture is understandable, but its local contact geometry remains schematic despite the detailed surface texture.

emotion_control.observation: The vivid orange/teal faces and open mouths communicate energetic shared reading. The brush title reinforces that lively invitation while the orderly paper details keep an adult cultural-event register.

ai_slop.observation: The mismatch between connected relief channels and separated printed strokes is an unresolved construction inconsistency at the key activity cue. Detailed scratch texture gives the objects finish but does not explain the incompatible silhouettes.
